archetypes.name: exit-code-threading
archetypes.rationale: The plan adds exit 4 to design-publish.sh and requires it to be carved out from every SKILL.md gate point; missing even one gate causes either premature advancement or abort on the defects-found path, a failure mode the plan itself names.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify that the plan threads exit-code 4 through every SKILL.md gate where _publish_rc is checked: the anti-halt continuation reminder, the final-summary block, the step-5c sentinel, the plan-write-failure/preserve-tmpdir branch, the Step 5d recap gate, and the unexpected-rc abort guard. For each gate, confirm the plan text specifies the rc-4 carve-out explicitly and does not rely on a reader inferring it. Check whether any gate point that currently conditions on _publish_rc ∈ {0,1,3} is omitted from the plan's update list. Also verify that test-design-structure.sh pins for each of those gate points are updated or newly added in the plan, not left as stale line-number references. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: parse-state-lifecycle
archetypes.rationale: The plan introduces a file-first/stdout-fallback result-env parse with rm -f quarantine before each retry and full replacement of _publish_out/_publish_rc/env fields after every attempt; any underspecified step in this lifecycle lets stale defects-found state flow into items 3-5.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace the full lifecycle of .design-publish-result.env and _publish_rc/_publish_out across the initial invoke, rc-4 Fix retry, rc-4 Override/Accept retry, and Cancel paths as described in the plan. Confirm the plan specifies rm -f .design-publish-result.env before every attempt (including Override), that all five VALIDATE_* keys are listed in every parse-case-arm update (SKILL.md Step 5c and design-publish.md result-env allowlist), and that the plan covers the edge case where a prior rc-4 env file exists when the operator retries. Check whether the stdout-fallback parse path for rc 3 is still consistent with the new file-first path after the rm -f quarantine is added. Confirm test-design-publish.sh cases cover the stale-env quarantine behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
